user.title: Climate Comfort
user.description: What would you like to set up?

room.title: Room Thermostat
room.description: Create a multi-stage thermostat for one room. Devices are added after creation via the **Configure** button.

data_description.temperature_sensor: The sensor whose reading drives all heating and cooling decisions for this room.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Only needed if you are adding a dehumidifier device to this room.
data_description.comfort_zone: Half-width of the dead zone either side of the target temperature (±°C). No devices run while the room is inside this band.
data_description.house_mode_entity: Optional. A select entity (away / sleep / home / comfort / eco / activity / boost) that overrides the active preset for this room. The **House Mode** entity created by the Global Defaults entry works here.
data_description.use_global_presets: When on, Sleep / Home / Comfort / Eco / Activity / Boost temperatures are inherited from the Global Defaults entry and the preset step is skipped. Away always follows the shared minimum / maximum safety temperatures.

presets.title: Preset Temperatures
presets.description:
Set the target temperature for each preset mode.

**Away** uses a protection band rather than a setpoint — nothing runs while the room is between Away Low and Away High.

data_description.preset_away_low: **Heating** only activates if the room drops below this temperature.
data_description.preset_away_high: **Cooling** only activates if the room exceeds this temperature.

global_defaults.title: Global Defaults
global_defaults.description:
Default values used by all rooms that have **Use global preset temperatures** enabled.

A **House Mode** selector is created automatically. Add floor names below to also create per-floor selectors.

data_description.comfort_zone: Half-width of the dead zone (±°C). Applied as the starting value for new rooms.
data_description.preset_away_low: **Heating** only activates if the room drops below this when Away is active.
data_description.preset_away_high: **Cooling** only activates if the room exceeds this when Away is active.
data_description.floor_names: Each entry creates a mode selector on the Global Settings device (e.g. 'Ground Floor', 'First Floor'). Rooms choose which selector to follow via their house / floor mode entity setting. Existing HA floor names are offered as suggestions; you can also type custom names.

abort.global_already_configured: Global defaults already exist — edit them via the Configure button.
abort.already_configured: A room with this name already exists. Use a different name or edit the existing room.

data_description.label: A short descriptive name shown on the device page, e.g. *Radiator*, *AirCon Fan*.
data_description.entity_id: The switch, climate, or fan entity this controller will turn on and off.
data_description.role:
**Heating** — activates when the room is too cold.
**Cooling** — activates when the room is too hot.
**Dehumidifier** — activates based on humidity, independent of temperature.

data_description.label: A short descriptive name shown on the device page.
data_description.entity_id: The switch, climate, or fan entity this controller will turn on and off.
data_description.role:
**Heating** — activates when the room is too cold.
**Cooling** — activates when the room is too hot.
**Dehumidifier** — activates based on humidity, independent of temperature.

data_description.activate_offset: How far beyond the comfort zone boundary before this device activates. **Heating devices** activate this many °C *below* the lower boundary. **Cooling devices** activate this many °C *above* the upper boundary. Set to 0 to activate exactly at the boundary.
data_description.deactivate_offset: How far the temperature must recover past the activation point before this device turns off. Prevents rapid on/off cycling.

data.dehumidify_only_when_idle: Only run when not heating or cooling

data_description.humidity_threshold: The relative humidity level at which this device switches on.
data_description.humidity_hysteresis: Humidity must drop this many percent below the threshold before the device switches off.
data_description.dehumidify_only_when_idle: When on, dehumidification is suppressed while heating or cooling is active.

data_description.hvac_mode_on: **HVAC mode:** the mode set on this climate entity when the controller activates it. The list is populated from the device's own supported modes.
data_description.target_temp_offset: **Target overshoot:** an optional offset to ensure the device actually runs rather than sitting idle because its previous setpoint was already satisfied. **Heating devices** target *setpoint + offset* °C. **Cooling devices** target *setpoint − offset* °C. Set to 0 to target exactly the room setpoint.
data_description.fan_mode: **Fan speed:** optional. Applied when this device is switched on, after the HVAC mode above. The list comes from the device's own supported fan modes. Choose *Leave unchanged* to let the device keep whatever speed it was last set to.
data_description.swing_mode: **Fan direction:** optional. Applied when this device is switched on, after the HVAC mode above. The list comes from the device's own supported swing modes. Choose *Leave unchanged* to let the device keep its current direction.

edit_settings.title: Room Settings
edit_settings.description: Sensor and zone settings for this room.

data_description.temperature_sensor: **Temperature sensor:** drives all heating and cooling decisions for this room.
data_description.humidity_sensor: **Humidity sensor:** optional. Required only if a dehumidifier device is configured for this room.
data_description.comfort_zone: **Comfort zone width (±°C):** half-width of the dead zone either side of the target temperature. Nothing runs while the room is inside this band. For example, ±1 °C with a 21 °C setpoint creates a 20–22 °C dead zone.
data_description.house_mode_entity: **House / floor mode entity:** optional. A select entity whose state (away / sleep / home / comfort / eco / activity / boost) overrides the active preset for this room. The **House Mode** entity from the Global Defaults entry works here.
data_description.use_global_presets: **Use global preset temperatures:** when on, Sleep / Home / Comfort / Eco / Activity / Boost temperatures are inherited from the Global Defaults entry. Turning this off lets you set room-specific values. Away always follows the shared minimum / maximum safety temperatures.
data_description.manual_hold_hours: **Manual override hold period:** when any controlled device is changed by someone other than this integration (manually, via an automation, or voice control), automated control of that device is suspended for this many hours. 0 = disabled — the integration always controls devices regardless of manual changes.
data_description.manual_hold_confirm_seconds: How long a device state mismatch must persist before it is treated as a manual override. Increase this if holds trigger too easily because devices report state slowly.

data_description.preset_away_low: **Heating** only activates if the room drops below this temperature.

edit_room_presets.description: Set temperatures specific to this room. **Away** uses a protection band — nothing runs while the room is between Away Low and Away High.

data_description.preset_away_low: **Heating** only activates if the room drops below this temperature.
data_description.preset_away_high: **Cooling** only activates if the room exceeds this temperature.

edit_global_general.title: Global Defaults — General limits
edit_global_general.description: Shared comfort zone and safety temperature bounds.

data_description.comfort_zone: Half-width of the dead zone (±°C). Applied as the starting value for new rooms.
data_description.minimum_temperature: Lowest safe temperature. Devices marked as emergency enabled can ignore Away protection to prevent the room dropping below this.
data_description.maximum_temperature: Highest safe temperature. Devices marked as emergency enabled can ignore Away protection to prevent the room rising above this.

edit_global_modes.title: Global Defaults — Mode temperatures
edit_global_modes.description: Target temperatures, aggressiveness profile, and availability used by each house mode. Away always uses the configured minimum and maximum safety temperatures.

data_description.mode_away_profile: Aggressiveness profile used while Away is active. Temperature protection bounds come from the global minimum and maximum temperatures.
data_description.mode_sleep_enabled: Turn the Sleep preset on or off in the generated selectors and climate entity.
data_description.mode_warmup_enabled: Turn the Comfort preset on or off in the generated selectors and climate entity.
data_description.mode_cooldown_enabled: Turn the Eco preset on or off in the generated selectors and climate entity.
data_description.mode_activity_enabled: Turn the Activity preset on or off in the generated selectors and climate entity.
data_description.mode_boost_enabled: Turn the Boost preset on or off in the generated selectors and climate entity.

edit_global_profiles.title: Global Defaults — Aggressiveness profiles
edit_global_profiles.description: Choose a profile group to edit.

edit_global_floors.title: Global Defaults — Floor mode selectors
edit_global_floors.description: Create optional per-floor mode selectors alongside the whole-house mode selector.

data_description.floor_names: Each entry creates a mode selector on the Global Settings device (e.g. 'Ground Floor', 'First Floor'). Rooms choose which selector to follow via their house / floor mode entity setting.

edit_room_aggressiveness.title: Room Aggressiveness
edit_room_aggressiveness.description: Choose a room-specific profile group to edit. Runtime profile can also be overridden from the room Aggressiveness select entity.

data_description.default_profile: Profile used when no runtime override is selected and no more specific fallback applies.

data_description.profile_relaxed_comfort_multiplier: Higher values widen the dead zone, so the room reacts less often.
data_description.profile_relaxed_point_spacing: Temperature spacing between staged activation points.

data_description.profile_responsive_comfort_multiplier: Lower values narrow the dead zone, so the room reacts sooner.
data_description.profile_responsive_point_spacing: Smaller spacing brings staged devices on sooner.

data_description.profile_aggressive_comfort_multiplier: Lowest comfort-zone multiplier for fastest reaction.
data_description.profile_aggressive_point_spacing: Smallest staged activation spacing for fastest escalation.
